cards.korean_title: 한국인 납치·감금 사건 두 배 증가
cards.english_title: Kidnapping cases involving Koreans double
cards.korean_desc: 지난해 해외에서 한국인 납치·감금 사건이 553건 발생했습니다. 특히 캄보디아에서 510건이 보고됐습니다.
cards.english_desc: There were 553 kidnapping and confinement cases involving Koreans overseas last year. Cambodia accounted for 510 of them.
cards.hook: Cambodia became the troubling center of a sharp rise.

cards.english_title: Dongguk builds global identity with Buddhism, Hallyu and AI
cards.korean_desc: 동국대학교는 불교, 한국 문화와 인공지능을 세계화의 기반으로 봅니다. 대학은 고유한 정체성을 발전시키려 합니다.
cards.english_desc: Dongguk University sees Buddhism, Korean culture and artificial intelligence as foundations for globalization. It aims to develop a unique identity.
cards.hook: Can ancient wisdom and cutting-edge AI share a campus?

cards.english_title: Ministries had no prior communication on relocation
cards.korean_desc: 외교부와 통일부는 세종시 이전 계획을 다른 정부 기관과 공식적으로 논의하지 않았습니다. 한 국회의원이 부처의 답변을 공개했습니다.
cards.english_desc: The Foreign and Unification ministries did not officially discuss their relocation plan with other government agencies. A lawmaker disclosed the ministries’ responses.
cards.hook: A government move began without much government conversation.

cards.english_title: Kim Jong-un returns after war memorial visit
cards.korean_desc: 김정은 북한 국무위원장이 중국 단둥의 한국전쟁 기념관을 방문한 뒤 육로로 귀국했습니다. 그는 새 다리를 건너 중국을 방문했습니다.
cards.english_desc: North Korean leader Kim Jong-un returned by road after visiting a Korean War memorial in Dandong, China. He crossed a new bridge during the visit.
cards.hook: A new bridge carried an old rivalry into fresh diplomacy.

cards.english_title: Kim Jong-un makes surprise China visit
cards.korean_desc: 김정은이 새 압록강 다리를 건너 중국 단둥을 깜짝 방문했습니다. 이번 방문은 한반도 외교에 대한 관심이 커지는 가운데 이루어졌습니다.
cards.english_desc: Kim Jong-un made a surprise visit to Dandong, China, crossing the new Yalu River Bridge. The visit came amid renewed diplomatic attention to the Korean Peninsula.
cards.hook: A surprise crossing gives diplomacy a brand-new route.

cards.english_title: A new gateway between North Korea and China
cards.korean_desc: 북한과 중국을 연결하는 새 다리가 문을 열었습니다. 이 다리는 두 나라의 교류와 무역을 늘릴 새로운 관문으로 주목받고 있습니다.
cards.english_desc: A new bridge connecting North Korea and China has opened. It is drawing attention as a new gateway for trade and exchanges between the two countries.
cards.hook: One bridge, two neighbors, many possible journeys.

cards.korean_title: 김정은, 새 압록강 다리로 단둥 도착
cards.english_title: Kim Jong-un arrives in Dandong via new bridge
cards.korean_desc: 김정은이 토요일 새 압록강 다리를 통해 중국 단둥에 도착했습니다. 한국 통일부가 이 사실을 밝혔습니다.
cards.english_desc: Kim Jong-un arrived in Dandong, China, on Saturday via the new Yalu River Bridge. South Korea’s Unification Ministry confirmed it.
cards.hook: The bridge’s first big crossing came with a surprise guest.

cards.english_title: Experts discuss Lee’s pragmatic diplomacy
cards.korean_desc: 전문가들은 한국이 기술과 산업의 강점을 외교적 영향력으로 바꿔야 한다고 말했습니다. 또한 협력국에 실질적인 이익을 줘야 한다고 강조했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Experts said South Korea should turn its technological and industrial strengths into diplomatic influence. They also stressed delivering practical benefits to partners.
cards.hook: Can Korea turn strong industries into stronger friendships?

cards.english_title: AIA Life Korea draws 7,000 to K-pop concert
cards.korean_desc: AIA생명은 경기도 고양에서 K팝 콘서트를 열어 약 7,000명을 모았습니다. 말레이시아, 필리핀, 싱가포르 고객과 직원도 참석했습니다.
cards.english_desc: AIA Life Korea held a K-pop concert in Goyang, attracting about 7,000 people. Customers and employees from Malaysia, the Philippines and Singapore also attended.
cards.hook: This concert had customers, partners, and plenty of fan energy.

cards.english_title: South Korea ranks second in Q2 current-account surplus
cards.korean_desc: 한국은 반도체 수출 증가에 힘입어 2분기 경상수지 흑자 규모에서 주요 경제국 중 2위를 기록했습니다. 흑자는 1,166억 3천만 달러였습니다.
cards.english_desc: South Korea ranked second among major economies in second-quarter current-account surpluses, helped by strong chip exports. Its surplus was $116.63 billion.
cards.hook: Chips helped Korea’s balance sheet shine brightly.

cards.english_title: Nearly half of Koreans report fatigue
cards.korean_desc: 조사 대상 한국인의 절반 가까이가 충분히 쉬어도 계속 피곤하다고 답했습니다. 평균 수면 시간은 6.3시간으로 줄었습니다.
cards.english_desc: Nearly half of surveyed South Koreans said they remained tired despite getting enough rest. Average sleep fell to 6.3 hours.
cards.hook: The national alarm clock may be ringing too early.

cards.english_title: Samsung Exynos chip beats Qualcomm in test
cards.korean_desc: 삼성전자의 차세대 엑시노스 2700이 내부 CPU 시험에서 퀄컴의 최고급 칩보다 약 20% 높은 점수를 냈습니다. 이 칩은 내년 갤럭시 S27에 탑재될 전망입니다.
cards.english_desc: Samsung’s next-generation Exynos 2700 scored about 20 percent higher than Qualcomm’s top chip in an internal CPU test. It is expected to appear in the Galaxy S27 next year.
cards.hook: Samsung’s next chip just found an extra gear.

cards.korean_title: 쌀 소비 감소에 CJ, 햇반 해외 공략
cards.english_title: CJ looks overseas as Koreans eat less rice
cards.korean_desc: 한국인의 쌀 소비가 줄자 CJ제일제당이 햇반의 해외 판매 확대에 나섰습니다. 햇반은 한국 즉석밥 시장에서 약 65%를 차지합니다.
cards.english_desc: As rice consumption falls in Korea, CJ CheilJedang is expanding overseas sales of Hetbahn. Hetbahn holds about 65 percent of Korea’s instant-rice market.
cards.hook: Less rice at home means more rice on the world stage.

cards.english_title: Woori Financial profit tops 1 trillion won again
cards.korean_desc: 우리금융그룹은 올해 첫 9개월 동안 2조 6,600억 원의 순이익을 기록했습니다. 일회성 이익을 제외하면 지난해보다 18.7% 증가했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Woori Financial Group posted 2.66 trillion won in net profit during the first nine months of the year. Excluding one-off gains, profit rose 18.7 percent from a year earlier.
cards.hook: Woori’s profit streak keeps crossing the trillion-won line.

cards.korean_title: 서울 증시, 저가 매수로 소폭 상승
cards.english_title: Seoul stocks edge up on bargain hunting
cards.korean_desc: 서울 증시는 전날 급락 뒤 반도체주 저가 매수세에 힘입어 소폭 올랐습니다. 원화도 달러화보다 강세를 보였습니다.
cards.english_desc: Seoul stocks edged up after the previous day’s sharp drop, helped by bargain hunting in chip stocks. The won also strengthened against the dollar.
cards.hook: After a tumble, bargain hunters went shopping for chips.

cards.korean_title: 노후 IT 보안 위험에 기업들 경고
cards.english_title: AmCham and Cisco warn of aging IT security risks
cards.korean_desc: 주한미국상공회의소와 시스코가 오래된 IT 시스템의 보안 위험에 주의하라고 촉구했습니다. 기업들은 변화하는 인공지능 위협에 대응해야 합니다.
cards.english_desc: AmCham Korea and Cisco urged businesses to address security risks from aging IT systems. Companies must respond to a changing artificial-intelligence threat landscape.
cards.hook: Old systems may be quietly inviting new trouble.

cards.english_title: Korea projects artistic soft power in London
cards.korean_desc: 한국의 문화와 예술 상품이 영국에서 큰 인기를 얻고 있습니다. K팝, 영화, 게임, 음식과 뷰티 제품이 영국 시장에 자리 잡았습니다.
cards.english_desc: South Korean cultural and artistic products are highly popular in Britain. K-pop, films, games, food and beauty products have become established in the UK market.
cards.hook: Korea’s cultural wave is still making stylish ripples in London.

cards.english_title: Cruise visitors to Korea near 1.3 million
cards.korean_desc: 올해 1월부터 8월까지 크루즈선을 타고 한국에 온 외국인이 128만 명에 달했습니다. 중국인 관광객이 증가를 이끌었습니다.
cards.english_desc: From January through August, 1.28 million foreigners arrived in Korea by cruise ship. Chinese visitors drove much of the increase.
cards.hook: Korea’s visitor count is sailing toward a major milestone.

cards.english_title: Jinyoung makes the case for reading slowly
cards.korean_desc: 가수 진영은 아이돌이 된 뒤 책을 읽기 시작했습니다. 그는 천천히 읽는 일이 반복되는 생활 속에서 마음을 깨우는 데 도움이 됐다고 말합니다.
cards.english_desc: Singer Jinyoung began reading after becoming an idol. He says reading slowly helped awaken his mind amid a repetitive life.
cards.hook: Could slowing down be the fastest way to refresh your mind?

cards.english_title: Inside Seoul’s multimillion-won coffee world
cards.korean_desc: 서울의 한 커피 전문점은 희귀한 원두와 맞춤형 추출법으로 최고 350만 원짜리 커피를 제공합니다. 커피가 특별한 사치 경험이 되고 있습니다.
cards.english_desc: A Seoul specialty coffee shop offers coffee costing up to 3.5 million won, using rare beans and tailored brewing. Coffee is becoming a luxury experience.
cards.hook: At this café, your coffee may cost more than your phone.

cards.english_title: Deborah Turbeville’s photos are all about atmosphere
cards.korean_desc: 데버라 터브빌의 사진은 흐릿하고 낡은 듯한 분위기를 보여줍니다. 사진 속 모델들은 현실과 꿈 사이에 있는 유령처럼 보입니다.
cards.english_desc: Deborah Turbeville’s photographs have a hazy, decayed atmosphere. The models look like ghosts between reality and dreams.
cards.hook: These glamorous photos seem to remember their own ghosts.

cards.english_title: Justin Bieber visits Seongsu for brand debut
cards.korean_desc: 저스틴 비버가 가수로 공연하지 않고 자신의 브랜드를 홍보하기 위해 한국을 찾았습니다. 그의 브랜드 스카일라크는 성수동에 첫 팝업 매장을 열었습니다.
cards.english_desc: Justin Bieber visited Korea to promote his own brand rather than perform as a singer. His brand Skylrk opened its first pop-up store in Seongsu.
cards.hook: Bieber returned to Korea, but this time the stage was a storefront.

cards.english_title: K/DA and LoL Worlds expand offline in Korea
cards.korean_desc: 라이엇게임즈가 롤 월드 챔피언십과 K/DA의 귀환을 기념해 한국에서 팝업 매장과 한정 상품을 선보입니다. 게임 속 세계가 현실로 확장됩니다.
cards.english_desc: Riot Games is presenting pop-up stores and limited merchandise in Korea to celebrate LoL Worlds and K/DA’s return. The game world is expanding offline.
cards.hook: The game is leaving the screen—and bringing merch.

cards.english_title: 80% of Netflix subscribers watched Korean content
cards.korean_desc: 전 세계 넷플릭스 가입자의 약 80%가 한국 드라마나 영화를 본 것으로 나타났습니다. 한국 콘텐츠 200편 이상이 글로벌 톱10에 올랐습니다.
cards.english_desc: About 80 percent of Netflix subscribers worldwide have watched Korean shows or films. More than 200 Korean productions have entered the global Top 10.
cards.hook: Korean stories have become everyone’s streaming neighbors.

cards.korean_title: 김기동 감독, FC서울 우승 약속 지켜
cards.english_title: FC Seoul boss delivers championship promise
cards.korean_desc: 김기동 감독이 약속한 3년 안 우승을 지켰습니다. FC서울은 강원FC와 비긴 뒤 K리그1 우승을 확정했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Manager Kim Gi-dong fulfilled his promise to win a title within three years. FC Seoul clinched the K League 1 championship after drawing with Gangwon FC.
cards.hook: A three-year promise became a championship celebration.

cards.english_title: FC Seoul crowned K League 1 champions
cards.korean_desc: FC서울이 10년 만에 한국 프로축구 정상에 올랐습니다. 강원FC와 1대1로 비겼지만 남은 경기와 관계없이 우승을 차지했습니다.
cards.english_desc: FC Seoul won the South Korean professional football title for the first time in 10 years. Despite a 1-1 draw with Gangwon FC, it secured the championship with games remaining.
cards.hook: Ten years later, Seoul finally got its football crown back.

cards.korean_title: LIV 골프, 파산 전 임원진에 1560만 달러
cards.english_title: LIV Golf paid executives before bankruptcy
cards.korean_desc: LIV 골프가 파산 신청 전 임원 7명에게 1,560만 달러를 지급했습니다. 법원 기록에서 이 지급 내역이 공개됐습니다.
cards.english_desc: LIV Golf paid $15.6 million to seven executives before filing for bankruptcy. The payments were revealed in court records.
cards.hook: The golf drama continued off the course—and into court.

cards.english_title: South Korea to face Saudi Arabia and Qatar
cards.korean_desc: 한국 축구대표팀이 11월 도하에서 사우디아라비아와 카타르를 상대로 평가전을 치릅니다. 경기는 11월 13일과 17일에 열립니다.
cards.english_desc: South Korea’s national football team will play friendlies against Saudi Arabia and Qatar in Doha in November. The matches will be held on November 13 and 17.
cards.hook: Two desert tests await the Taegeuk Warriors.

cards.english_title: Cho Eun-hye wins Korea’s first Asian Para Games fencing gold
cards.korean_desc: 휠체어 펜싱 선수 조은혜가 여자 에페 B에서 금메달을 땄습니다. 한국은 아시아 패러게임 펜싱에서 처음으로 금메달을 얻었습니다.
cards.english_desc: Wheelchair fencer Cho Eun-hye won gold in the women’s epee B event. South Korea earned its first Asian Para Games fencing gold.
cards.hook: A one-point victory made para-fencing history for Korea.
cards.korean_hook: 한 점 차 승리가 역사를 썼다

cards.english_title: Open champion Oosthuizen to leave LIV Golf
cards.korean_desc: 2010년 브리티시 오픈 우승자 루이 오스투이젠이 LIV 골프를 떠납니다. 그는 이번 결정을 인생에서 가장 어려운 결정 중 하나라고 말했습니다.
cards.english_desc: 2010 British Open champion Louis Oosthuizen is leaving LIV Golf. He called the decision one of the hardest of his life.
cards.hook: A major champion is choosing a new fairway.

cards.english_title: Bayern draws Arsenal 2-2
cards.korean_desc: 바이에른 뮌헨이 아스널과 2대2로 비겼습니다. 한국 수비수 김민재는 선발 출전했지만 전반전만 뛰었습니다.
cards.english_desc: Bayern Munich drew 2-2 with Arsenal. South Korean defender Kim Min-jae started but played only the first half.
cards.hook: Kim’s first-half shift helped set up a heavyweight draw.

cards.english_title: Angels fire manager Kurt Suzuki after 100-loss season
cards.korean_desc: LA 에인절스가 62승 100패를 기록한 뒤 커트 스즈키 감독을 해임했습니다. 구단은 새 감독과 코치진을 찾기 시작했습니다.
cards.english_desc: The Los Angeles Angels fired manager Kurt Suzuki after a 62-100 season. The club began searching for a new manager and coaching staff.
cards.hook: A 100-loss season brought a very unfunny changeup.

cards.english_title: Santos Bravos announces first-anniversary release
cards.korean_desc: 라틴 팝 그룹 산토스 브라보스가 데뷔 1주년을 맞아 11월 20일 새 음원을 발표합니다. 이번 음원은 그룹의 첫 기념일 발매입니다.
cards.english_desc: Latin pop group Santos Bravos will release new music on November 20 for its first anniversary. It will be the group’s first anniversary release.
cards.hook: One year old, and Santos Bravos already has birthday music.

cards.korean_title: TWS, 두 번째 싱글로 팬들을 밝힌다
cards.english_title: TWS to light up fans with second single
cards.korean_desc: TWS가 두 번째 싱글 ‘To Us’를 11월 2일 발표합니다. 앨범에는 팬들이 즐길 수 있는 조명 패키지도 포함됩니다.
cards.english_desc: TWS will release its second single, “To Us,” on November 2. The album includes a lighting package for fans to enjoy.
cards.hook: TWS is putting a little glow inside the album.

cards.english_title: I-dle’s Minnie teases solo EP
cards.korean_desc: 아이들의 민니가 솔로 디지털 EP의 음원 일부를 공개했습니다. EP에는 서로 다른 감정을 담은 세 곡이 들어갑니다.
cards.english_desc: I-dle’s Minnie released snippets from her solo digital EP. The EP will contain three songs expressing different emotions.
cards.hook: Minnie offers three emotional clues before the full moon rises.
cards.korean_hook: 민니가 세 가지 감정을 살짝 공개

cards.english_title: Illit’s upcoming EP gets 500,000 Spotify pre-saves
cards.korean_desc: 아일릿의 다섯 번째 EP가 발매 전 스포티파이 선저장 50만 건을 넘겼습니다. 앨범은 월요일에 공개됩니다.
cards.english_desc: Illit’s fifth EP surpassed 500,000 Spotify pre-saves before release. The album will be released Monday.
cards.hook: Half a million listeners saved the surprise before hearing it.

cards.english_title: BTS music video ‘2.0’ reaches 200 million views
cards.korean_desc: BTS의 ‘2.0’ 뮤직비디오가 유튜브 조회수 2억 회를 넘겼습니다. 정규 5집 ‘아리랑’에서 이 기록을 세운 첫 영상입니다.
cards.english_desc: BTS’s “2.0” music video surpassed 200 million YouTube views. It is the first video from their fifth album, “Arirang,” to reach the milestone.
cards.hook: BTS turns “2.0” into a very large viewing party.

cards.english_title: Aoora headlines music festival finale in India
cards.korean_desc: 뭄바이에 기반을 둔 한국 가수 아우라가 인도 케랄라 음악축제의 마지막 무대를 장식했습니다. 그는 자신의 노래와 말라얄람 인기곡을 불렀습니다.
cards.english_desc: Mumbai-based Korean singer Aoora headlined the finale of a music festival in Kerala, India. He performed his own songs and popular Malayalam songs.
cards.hook: A Korean voice gave India’s festival finale a global encore.

cards.english_title: A2O Soul to release debut album in November
cards.korean_desc: 15인조 보이그룹 A2O 소울이 11월 9일 데뷔 EP ‘Superstar’를 발표합니다. 앨범에는 ‘Superstar’와 ‘Dancing in the Dark’ 등이 수록됩니다.
cards.english_desc: The 15-member boy group A2O Soul will release its debut EP, “Superstar,” on November 9. The album includes “Superstar” and “Dancing in the Dark.”
cards.hook: Fifteen members are ready to make one very big entrance.

cards.english_title: Ian Eastwood reconnects with Korea’s dance scene
cards.korean_desc: 미국 안무가 아이언 이스트우드는 한국에서 데뷔 전 예술가들을 가르치며 깊은 인상을 받았습니다. 그는 한국의 춤 문화와 다시 연결되고 있습니다.
cards.english_desc: American choreographer Ian Eastwood was impressed while teaching pre-debut artists in Korea. He is reconnecting with Korea’s dance culture.
cards.hook: A choreographer returns—and finds Korea’s next moves waiting.

cards.english_title: California officials frustrated by ballot demand
cards.korean_desc: 미 법무부가 비시민권자에게 보내졌다고 판단한 투표용지를 따로 보관하라고 요구했습니다. 캘리포니아 선거관리자들은 혼란과 불만을 나타냈습니다.
cards.english_desc: The US Justice Department demanded that ballots it believes went to noncitizens be set aside. California election officials expressed confusion and frustration.
cards.hook: A ballot box dispute is rattling California’s election workers.

cards.english_title: Israeli forces displace Hebron families after attack
cards.korean_desc: 이스라엘군이 공격 다음 날 요르단강 서안 헤브론에서 약 2,000명의 주민을 대피시켰습니다. 팔레스타인 자치정부는 국제사회의 압박을 요구했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Israeli forces displaced about 2,000 residents in Hebron in the West Bank after an attack. The Palestinian Authority called for international pressure.
cards.hook: A deadly attack was followed by a mass evacuation.

cards.english_title: Obama attacks Trump allies’ campaign conduct
cards.korean_desc: 버락 오바마 전 대통령이 트럼프 대통령과 공화당 동맹의 잔혹함과 부적절한 행동을 비판했습니다. 그는 오하이오에서 민주당 유권자들을 독려했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Former President Barack Obama criticized what he called cruelty and indecency by President Trump and Republican allies. He rallied Democratic voters in Ohio.
cards.hook: Obama stepped into a campaign fight already running hot.

cards.english_title: Ukraine says Starshield restored, Musk disputes terms
cards.korean_desc: 우크라이나는 스타링크와 군사용 스타실드가 정상적으로 작동한다고 밝혔습니다. 그러나 일론 머스크는 우크라이나군이 회사 약관을 위반했다고 주장했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Ukraine said Starlink and military Starshield were fully functional again. Elon Musk, however, claimed that Ukraine’s military had violated the company’s terms.
cards.hook: The signal returned, but the argument stayed online.

cards.korean_title: 유럽 위기 속 병력 배치된 밀라노
cards.english_title: Soldiers guard Milan amid European crisis
cards.korean_desc: 이탈리아 여러 도시에서 수천 명의 젊은이들이 시위에 참여했습니다. 당국은 과거의 폭력 사태를 막기 위해 경찰과 군인을 대규모로 배치했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Thousands of young people protested in several Italian cities. Authorities deployed large numbers of police and soldiers to prevent a repeat of earlier violence.
cards.hook: Milan’s streets saw a tense mix of protest and protection.

cards.korean_title: PHP 보안 결함에 해킹 시도 급증
cards.english_title: Hacking attempts surge after PHP flaws disclosed
cards.korean_desc: PHP의 심각한 보안 결함이 공개되자 기업과 정부가 서둘러 시스템을 고치고 있습니다. 클라우드 기업들은 해킹 시도가 급증했다고 보고했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Companies and governments are rushing to fix serious PHP security flaws after their disclosure. Cloud firms reported a surge in hacking attempts.
cards.hook: Hackers spotted the cracks before everyone finished patching.

cards.korean_title: 해외 한국어 교육, 학생 19만 명 돌파
cards.english_title: Korean-language education expands overseas
cards.korean_desc: 2025년 해외 한국어 수업 등록자는 19만 1,896명으로 5년 전보다 약 50% 늘었습니다. 47개국 2,777개 학교에서 한국어를 가르쳤습니다.
cards.english_desc: Enrollment in overseas Korean-language classes reached 191,896 in 2025, about 50 percent higher than five years earlier. Korean was taught at 2,777 schools in 47 countries.
cards.hook: Korean class is becoming a global after-school favorite.

cards.english_title: Meta ordered to pay $25 billion privacy penalty
cards.korean_desc: 뉴멕시코 법원이 개인정보 사건과 관련해 메타에 250억 달러를 지급하라고 명령했습니다. 배심원단은 메타가 데이터 개인정보 보호에 대해 소비자를 속였다고 판단했습니다.
cards.english_desc: A New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay $25 billion over a data privacy case. A jury found that Meta misled consumers about protecting their data.
cards.hook: Meta’s privacy bill just became extremely hard to ignore.
